name: 4745-sharedprefix-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of the gated `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`, same weights and same config.json shape fields; 15 GiB over four safetensors.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU. SM>=90 is required: the engine asserts it for the `fa3` attention backend.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, bf16, 8192 max positions -- all of it readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 960 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 42. Each request is one of FOUR fixed 6144-token context blocks followed by a unique 128-token question, generating 128 tokens; both lengths fixed (stdev 0). guidellm emits the block as its own `prefix` column, so total input is 6272 tokens.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant answering questions about four fixed long documents, 16 concurrent users, single GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit 92bb49a7f95bdaadcfc87a3cfd12c5e4a886e60c (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.4.4.post2-6-g92bb49a7f95); the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine then
# starts without the mechanism this file declares, at rc=0.

# An ungated re-upload of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`; the canonical id is gated here.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# fa3 at this commit asserts SM>=90, refuses a page size above 1, and imports compiled kernels
# that come from the base image rather than from pip -- see configs/env.yaml.
attention-backend: fa3

random-seed: 42
